title: Orientation and external shading limit summer sun to habitable rooms and permit winter sun per A4.1.1(a)
text: The building is oriented and incorporates external shading devices in order to: minimise direct sunlight to habitable rooms: between late September and early March in climate zones 4, 5 and 6 only AND in all seasons in climate zones 1 and 3; permit winter sun to habitable rooms in accordance with A 4.1.1 (a).
notes: Judgment: 'minimise' and 'permit' set no measure. Figure 4.1a gives summer and winter solar angles for Perth (81 / 34 degrees), Broome (summer printed as -6, winter 49) and Albany (78 / 31). Climate zone 2 is not mentioned.
